name: fix_rust_utf8_byte_slice_panic
description: Fixes first-character extraction that byte-slices &s[0..1] and panics on multi-byte UTF-8
prompts: The function `initial(s: &str) -> String` in src/lib.rs should return the first CHARACTER of the string (as a String), or an empty string if `s` is empty. It's broken: it uses the byte slice `&s[0..1]`, which panics with 'byte index is not a char boundary' whenever the first character is multi-byte UTF-8 (e.g. 'ü', an emoji), and also panics on an empty string. Fix `initial` to return the first Unicode scalar value correctly (use the chars iterator), returning "" for an empty string. Keep the function name and signature.
